description: This Kotlin source file defines the MockRepository class, which provides local mock data and simple persistence mechanisms for a fitness app. It manages workout data, user profile, goals, badges, and progress entries, including methods for retrieving, updating, and searching data.

classes.name: MockRepository
classes.description: A mock data repository for managing workout, profile, badge, and progress data in a fitness app.

methods.name: defaultProfile
methods.description: Creates a default user profile with preset values and preferences.

methods.name: goalFromPrefs
methods.description: Retrieves goal settings from shared preferences.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates user profile data in shared preferences and updates associated goals.

methods.name: updateGoal
methods.description: Updates user goal data in shared preferences.

methods.name: getRecommended
methods.description: Provides a list of recommended workouts based on profile goals, preferences, and filters.

methods.name: getWorkouts
methods.description: Returns the list of all workouts.

methods.name: searchWorkouts
methods.description: Searches workouts matching a query string.

methods.name: recentProgress
methods.description: Generates mock progress data for the last 7 days.
